title: config/art-placeholders.json (the registry of gray-box placeholders and the milestone that replaces each, M10d1, DL-390, DL-741)

match.description: A regular expression over AssetRef strings (`^vehicle/graybox\.`), or `code:<name>` for a placeholder that lives in code and has no AssetRef.

replacedBy.description: The AssetRefs that stand in the placeholder's place (a trailing `*` names a family the owner fills in). Required non-empty for rows owned by M10d1.

repoint.description: Old AssetRef to new AssetRef; `assets:vehicle -- --repoint` rewrites prefab `render.asset` with it.
